record.reason: This is a robustness study of latent-reasoning models under adversarial perturbations, rather than a new inference optimization. It discusses how latent vectors can shorten explicit reasoning trajectories and reduce memory/latency, but its experiments assess attack robustness across a limited set of models; the primary text explicitly frames results as robustness-risk evidence, not a complete LRM characterization. Its latent-inference connection is plausible but indirect.
record.title: Assessing Adversarial Robustness of Latent Reasoning Models
